name.km: ចំហុយម្ជូរកង្កែប

description: Steamed with pickled sour plum, lime and chili for a tangy lift.
descriptionKm: ចំហុយម្ជូរ — ផ្លែឈើជូរ និងទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងចំហុយ

ingredients.itemKm: ផ្លែព្រូនជ្រក់
ទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ
ម្ទេសស្រស់

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Prepare the frog: cleaned and jointed.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំកង្កែប៖ សម្អាត ហើយកាត់តាមសន្លាក់។

instructions.text: Arrange on a heatproof plate and scatter over the aromatics.
Steam over rapidly boiling water until tender.
instructions.tip: Don't over-steam — pull it the moment it is just cooked to keep it tender.

instructions.text: Drizzle over the sauce, top with the fresh garnish, and serve with rice.
